output.content: The change affects cert-manager only when it runs with `--namespace=<namespace>`. The environment summary shows four values keys (global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled, prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, replicaCount), and none of them sets that flag. The summary does not show controller extraArgs or the Deployment's container args, so it cannot confirm whether the flag is used. Check the cert-manager Deployment (apps/v1) args for `--namespace` to see if the fix applies.
output.title: Namespace-scoped flag fix: usage not visible in environment
